title: ieee1905: Add Wi-Fi 7 Agent Capabilities TLV
description:
This commit adds the "Wi-Fi 7 Agent Capabilities TLV" and the "Early AP Capability Report CMDU".

See Wi-Fi EasyMesh Specification Version 6.0 chatper 17.2.95 and 17.1.62
